body:
CANONICAL: live TermAl host workarounds for Engram agents. Source Engram::Fable. Each line names the TermAl item whose fix retires it; when one is fixed and live, revise this entry. TermAl CREDIT never gates an Engram landing: the launcher's own freeze check (results.json expected = before = after) does. Rev 64 (2026-10-18 06:25Z) compacts rev 62 and corrects the credited-command form.

!! REVIEW INTEGRITY (P1 w-9d4b9b00c603, still recurring 10-18 05:49Z): a COMPACT delegation result can say "Findings: None" while the FULL output lists findings. Judge every review, explorer or evaluator result ONLY from the FULL paged output (read until complete:true). Parent-scoped results can't be read by other sessions (404 is expected); the parent reads them and relays the full text. Record explorer results on the item promptly.

!! CLAUDE SESSIONS: never start a background Bash task or a subagent; TermAl restricts the session's test credit until it ends. Keep store checks short (never `engram doctor` on a live store from the foreground tool).

CHECKS AND CREDIT
- Run checks through `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused -- ...` (or full). Results persist in .git/worktrees/<wt>/review-runs/<test>/results.json. A BARE command that outlives its turn loses its result (TermAl w-8f7e2d914724).
- CLAUDE lanes: TermAl's turn header prescribes ONE call of the form `pushd "DIR" && <test>`, and it IS credited (records d4259a0b, 634eccf6, 53722ba3). Piping, redirecting or chaining AFTER or around the test makes it uncredited (w-1d9259ed138e). A separate earlier cd call is NOT reliable. CODEX lanes run launcher commands through native exec.
- Credit binds to the turn's FOCUSED claim. Never rerun only for credit.
- Nothing wakes an idle session (w-1df557dae3ac): the coordinator wakes lanes after a "next turn" step.
- Overlapped checks are indeterminate (w-10eafa34c480). Codex: a focused run is recorded only if it ends while its starting turn is open (w-67d248c998ef).
- Under host load, a passing detached gate can be refused credit with "no run appeared within ten minutes" (P1 w-645c884b2cbc, 10 s association slack). results.json stays the evidence; no credit rerun unless a bound Test criterion needs host verification.
- A cancelled or idle delegation may keep holding a worktree folder: `git worktree remove` gets "Permission denied" (P2 w-eaee4f7c441c). Leave it; no force, no kill.
- A foreign command in a gate-carried root makes the host refuse that gate's credit (correct behaviour; w-0fd88ccb42dd). Never run commands in another lane's live root; take its diff from a frozen patch or commit.

NAMED SOURCE ROOTS
- Never root credited work at the MAIN checkout; use a clean detached worktree (.worktrees/NAME). termal_name_source_root {work, path}; it takes effect next turn. Clear: {work} with NO path, from a live claim. The 64-slot table is shared: own-clear after done. On a naming 502 (w-c2ad725f3ba8), retry the identical request once.
- After a host restart, claims may lapse (recover them with a reason) and roots may need re-naming. Detached gates survive a restart.

GATES: from the named root, FOREGROUND: `node scripts/test-launcher.mjs full --detach --notify session-5135` (Claude lanes never background, P1 w-b576a44fb793). START to Fable2 before LAUNCH NOW; gate and pair in parallel; a failed gate discards that round's reviews. No edits in a gated root; no supported cancel. Check `df -B1G /c` before gates.

EVALUATIONS (P1 w-539ea7e8b506): after termal_evaluate_acceptance, make no tracker write that turn. Reusing a settled evaluator or explorer may fail: 409 "thread was archived manually" or 500 "timed out waiting for ... thread/unarchive" (w-049ac52c3f72). Then spawn ONE fresh one; don't retry the reuse. One holder note per criterion, at most 3.5 KB. Closure: land, fresh evaluation, done, own-clear LAST; FF main only after done.

APPROVALS AND QUEUES: Codex lanes are on host AUTO-APPROVE. A lane waiting for a human is PARKED: tell Fable2. queuePaused=true for under a minute between turns is normal (w-80e0 pattern); a wake may report durableButNotWoken or heldBehindPausedQueue meanwhile. A persistently stuck head (w-7635e5349aab): ask Fable2 to cancel it and resume. A resumed turn may replay the OLD plan (w-e4c65f30c77b).

MAILBOX: an idempotency key is unique per SENDER across ALL recipients (P3 w-b7b80d980e7a), so use a recipient-qualified key per recipient when fanning out. Don't call list_mailboxes from the watchdog (huge); read known mailboxes.

OTHER: Codex "blocked by policy" refusals (w-e2a5af1634f0): plain single commands, never bypass. Reviewer briefs start with "read and follow .claude/commands/review-code.md". Never run TERMAL_CLI without a known subcommand. The watchdog cron lives only in the session; after a restart check CronList.

- Spurious "Evidence restricted ... then lifted" notice pairs on the coordinator session after watchdog cron ticks (P2 TermAl w-350df830dfd0; related to w-df1ef323efe9). They may refuse credit to lanes' focused runs under the main checkout during the window. No action is needed; if a lane's run loses credit in such a window, mail Fable2 the run id as evidence.

- ANY command run by a non-Claude session in a carried gate's root, even a read-only `git diff`, makes the host refuse that gate's credit (TermAl w-4a8d9a7a7d08). Export patches BEFORE the launch or after the END, or with `git -C` from MAIN against the shared object store when the content is committed. The landing evidence is the launcher's own results.json.
- After an OS crash: SQLite (Engram and TermAl) can lose the last minutes of commits (Engram w-088e358107e0; TermAl w-35bdcb766b6c). Re-verify recent records, and rerun lost evaluations on unchanged evidence.
